changelog:
Goofish-search-list 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Enables scraping of Goofish (闲鱼) second-hand item search results with support for keyword queries, sorting, price range, and publish-date filters.
- Returns structured lists of 30 item cards per page with id, title, price, image, location, and want-count.
- Handles login checks, CAPTCHA/rate-limiting, and pagination (up to 25 pages).
- Provides examples and detailed output structure for seamless integration.
- Includes clear success criteria, limitations, and batch execution best practices.
summary: Scrapes second-hand item search results from Goofish (闲鱼/xianyu, goofish.com) — China's largest second-hand marketplace. Input: keyword, optional sort/filter...
